instructions: Test the build artifact produced after implementation, not an older B1 artifact. Capture main and touch screens before/during/after an effect, record ROM SHA256 and result. Any test needing a source hook not implemented is NOT TESTABLE, not a pass. These tests do not change combat mechanics.

cases.moves: Flamethrower, Ember, Fire Blast, Flame Wheel
cases.expected: Fire bloom is visible and correctly attached to defender; sprite releases after impact
cases.evidence: Capture before hit, impact bloom, and next command menu; watch for missing tiles, palette swaps, double layers.

cases.moves: Ice Beam, Aurora Beam
cases.expected: Ranger ice bloom visible with correct cyan/blue palette, no pale rectangles
cases.evidence: Capture impact and one full subsequent turn.

cases.moves: Stone Edge, Ancient Power
cases.expected: Rock burst fragments play, settle and restore with no missing enemy sprite
cases.evidence: Inspect background and healthbox after each move.

cases.moves: Thunderbolt, Thunder Shock
cases.expected: Charge, discharge, impact and aftermath visibly distinct; arena tint returns
cases.evidence: Compare sprites and HUD immediately after action.

cases.moves: Shadow Ball
cases.expected: Spectral charge/travel/impact remain coordinated; final palette restores
cases.evidence: Run a second different move after Shadow Ball.

cases.moves: Surf
cases.expected: Wave covers intended battlers without dropping sprite layer or touching healthboxes
cases.evidence: Use two Pokémon per side; inspect target/hit sequencing.

cases.moves: Surf
cases.expected: Player partner/friendly-fire presentation is correct and no alternate branch skips cleanup
cases.evidence: Use a battle mode where Surf visually includes partner and enemy targets.

cases.moves: Rock Blast
cases.expected: Each repeated hit is readable; no leaked hit particles or OAM exhaustion
cases.evidence: Continue until move ends and next menu returns.

cases.moves: Ancient Power, Rock Blast
cases.expected: Contest-specific script path remains graphically intact and returns cleanly
cases.evidence: Use Contest context where supported by the test build.

cases.moves: Protect / immunity / miss cases
cases.expected: Presentation does not stall or leave cinematic layers when a normal hit does not occur
cases.evidence: Compare attacked and blocked turns; preserve game logic.

cases.moves: A representative beam and physical contact move
cases.expected: Focus/scroll/zoom effect is bounded; baseline battlefield composition exactly returns
cases.evidence: Record before/action/after, check battlers and command menu.

cases.moves: A representative area and projectile move
cases.expected: No camera displacement hides either partner, healthbox or controls
cases.evidence: Compare all four battler anchors before and after.

cases.moves: Thunderbolt with active rain
cases.expected: Transient electrical lighting composes correctly with persistent weather grade
cases.evidence: Check weather animation still active after strike and unaffected HUD colors.

cases.moves: Ice Beam / Surf on S2-D animated terrain
cases.expected: Existing terrain palette cycling continues correctly after scene fade
cases.evidence: Use source-supported special animated battlefield, compare before/after palette.

cases.moves: Shadow Ball then Flash Cannon then Thunderbolt
cases.expected: No cumulative tint, fade, flash or BG offset after multiple moves
cases.evidence: Inspect final scene when command menu returns.

cases.moves: A physical impact and a projectile
cases.expected: Reaction is clear but battler sprites return to exact baseline anchor
cases.evidence: Capture anticipation, hit recoil, first idle frame.

cases.moves: Substitute and then an impact move
cases.expected: Reactions do not reveal hidden original sprite or corrupt Substitute layers
cases.evidence: Compare Substitute display pre- and post-impact.

cases.moves: A powerful move causing a faint, followed by switch
cases.expected: Faint, cleanup and replacement are clean with no palette/OAM residue
cases.evidence: Run until next Pokémon has entered and HUD has settled.

cases.moves: Three low-power moves
cases.expected: No excessive charge delay; audio impact and visual contact occur together
cases.evidence: Observe responsiveness and command return.

cases.moves: Solar Beam and a high-power signature attack
cases.expected: Distinct charge and release without changing turn/timing mechanics
cases.evidence: Use charging and release turns separately.

cases.moves: Source-verified legendary encounter supported by Opal
cases.expected: Special intro appears only on intended encounter and restores normal battle state
cases.evidence: Compare normal wild encounter vs signature battle.

cases.moves: Leave special encounter via defeat, catch or other supported exit
cases.expected: No persistent visual task, wrong palette, or corrupted return to field
cases.evidence: Verify post-battle overworld graphics.

cases.moves: Battle HUD, move select, weather, signature effect
cases.expected: Opal pearl/mineral-violet/gold framing is coherent while element attacks retain distinct colors
cases.evidence: Capture main and touch screens across representative battles.

cases.moves: Long doubles battle with weather, spread and multi-hit attacks
cases.expected: No accumulating sprite corruption, stale particles, palette conflicts or UI regressions
cases.evidence: Repeat 10+ animations, inspect both screens after every turn.
